description: Knowledge-boundary (anti-omniscience) scenario: a character may only know what the state says she could know. A reply in which she knows the sealed winner is incoherent; a reply in which she wonders is coherent.
state: A sealed envelope names the competition winner: Theo.
Mara has never opened the envelope.

steps.response: Mara smiles to herself; she already knows Theo has won.
steps.claim: Mara only knows what she could know at this point.

steps.response: Mara turns the sealed envelope over, wondering whose name is inside.
steps.claim: Mara only knows what she could know at this point.
